changed.previousSay: The upper end sticks out by eleven points. Hold the decision. Even overlapping intervals for individual rates can't answer this paired-gap question. With sparse or identical observations, check that your interval procedure gives meaningful bounds.

A Wald interval can collapse to zero width after zero successes, regardless of sample size. Wilson intervals avoid that collapse and stay in zero-to-one bounds, with approximate nominal coverage for independent binomial trials. They do not turn selected fixtures into representative samples.

The individual intervals for five of six and three of six overlap, but that establishes neither equality nor equivalence. Put uncertainty on the paired TPR difference itself. Resample whole cases, and preserve customer or source clusters when appropriate. Predefine mandatory slices and handle multiple comparisons. A support floor is not by itself a power analysis.

For a chosen ten-percentage-point signed-gap tolerance, an illustrative interval from minus seven to plus eight passes the interval check. Minus two to plus twenty-one contains zero but fails because it extends beyond the tolerance. These are authored examples, not intervals estimated from the ten pairs. More bootstrap draws cannot create absent populations; identical observed outcomes can give misleadingly narrow bootstrap results.
The supplied candidate fixture clears point-estimate rate checks and has no paired flips. Evaluate a real candidate on representative model responses before release.
A release record also needs representative cases, uncertainty bounds on the paired gaps, approved group definitions, privacy review, and an owner for production monitoring.
Once deployed, watch resolution quality and waiting time across the reviewed slices. Reopen the audit when the policy, model, judge, or request population changes.

Finish with a new ready pair scoring point eight two and point seven six against the same point seven cutoff. Both enter the fast path, so this pair has no route flip. Does that clear release? No: representative evaluation, reviewed gap uncertainty, complete slice coverage, sufficient support, privacy approval and monitoring ownership remain separate gates. The original p four can be repaired on a test fixture while the overall release stays blocked. Hallucination detection next checks whether the generated reply actually follows its evidence.

beats.say: What if a rate is zero in six independent trials? The usual Wald calculation puts zero at both ends. Wilson still leaves room for outcomes you haven't seen. With zero successes its upper bound is z squared divided by six plus z squared. At ninety-five percent that's about thirty-nine percent.

The two wordings share a claim. To estimate uncertainty on their difference, resample both versions together. If a customer contributed several claims, preserve that cluster. Plan sample size for the gap you care about and account for comparing several slices. More bootstrap draws can't supply customers you never sampled.

Use a tolerance of ten points in either direction for the signed gap, formal minus conversational. These two intervals are examples. The first runs from minus seven to plus eight. It fits entirely inside the margin.
Try minus two to plus twenty-one. Zero is inside the interval. Does the whole interval fit the contract?

beats.say: Back at the release desk, start with the hand-written candidate table. Both wordings serve the same five ready claims. P six goes to review in both. Every unclear claim goes to review. This run passes the individual pair check and all four rate checks.

Try a second run. Change just two conversational scores. P one falls to point six. P six rises to point eight. The cutoff is still point seven. Our rule requires each verified pair to keep the same route. Does this run pass?

Block this run. P one loses the fast path when it's worded conversationally. P six gains it. Five ready claims still get service in each wording. The two flips cancel in the rate. They count separately in the pair check.

Put the first candidate back. Its fixture passes again. To release a real model, we still need a representative model evaluation, enough independent cases in every required slice, and a reviewed interval on the paired gap. Six ready and four unclear examples per wording leave that work open.

Hold the release until reviewers have representative results, approved group definitions and the privacy review. Back to the blender claim. Both versions get automatic service in the candidate table. How long did either customer actually wait?

We measured neither wait. Name someone to track waiting time and resolution quality across the reviewed slices after deployment. Reopen the audit when the policy, judge, model or customer population changes. Next, check whether the reply follows its evidence.
